text_simplified: The sheikh concludes his book by supplicating that Allah help in raising and directing children correctly, make them righteous, protect them from trials, and make them guided and guiding. Then he lists the ten pillars: (1) choosing a righteous spouse, (2) instilling aqeedah and faith, (3) abundant supplication, (4) fortification with adhkar, (5) choosing good names, (6) justice among children, (7) rifq and mercy, (8) sincere advice and guidance, (9) choosing righteous companions, and (10) setting a righteous example.
